# napari-freeimagetovideo

Free image to video AI with no daily cap: start with no sign-up, keep going on a free account. Every video comes with sound and no watermark.

A [napari](https://napari.org/) plugin for [Free Image to Video (freeimagetovideo.ai)](https://freeimagetovideo.ai/?utm_source=napari&utm_medium=package) that generates AI video clips from a text prompt or public image URL using MiniMax H3 and loads the decoded MP4 frames directly as a time-series RGB image layer.

## Installation

```bash
pip install napari-freeimagetovideo
```

Create an API key at [freeimagetovideo.ai/settings/apikeys](https://freeimagetovideo.ai/settings/apikeys) and set `FREEIMAGETOVIDEO_API_KEY` (or enter it directly in the widget). API runs require a paid plan ([pricing](https://freeimagetovideo.ai/pricing)); browser generation starts with no sign-up at [freeimagetovideo.ai](https://freeimagetovideo.ai/).

## Usage

1. Open napari and choose **Plugins -> Free Image to Video AI**.
2. Enter a motion prompt, optional public image URL (first frame), duration (`4`–`15` seconds), resolution (`480p` or `768p`), and aspect ratio (`16:9`, `9:16`, or `1:1`).
3. Click **Generate** to append the rendered video frames as an RGB image stack layer.
